reference_output.notes: Email contains two separate requests: (1) a voyage charter cargo inquiry (5,000 MT Paddy Rice, Thessaloniki → Tekirdag, SPOT) and (2) a period time charter request (min 12 months, ~2500 TEU, Black Sea delivery/redelivery, L/C 1st half April 2026). Both laycans/delivery windows are now past (original inner message dated 21 March 2026, forwarded late on 8 May 2026) — cargo/TC opportunities likely expired. Classified as CARGO_INQUIRY for the dominant voyage charter element. Unknown terms flagged: CHABE (unrecognized clause), IAC (possibly 'In Addition to Commission' but not standard), GCN (possibly GENCON variant but not confirmed), TCP (Time Charter Period — inferred but not in glossary).
